nameAndMeaning.title: Name and Meaning
nameAndMeaning.content: Sanchin (三戦) means "three battles" or "three struggles". Literally it is Japanese/Chinese for three (三, san) and battle/war (戦, chin). Traditionally this is interpreted as the struggle to unite shin-ki-tai (mind, technique, body). Other interpretations are "three parties" (technique, breath, posture). In essence, the name stands for the three aspects of strength training that Sanchin brings together.
